hooks.text: 没有法力、行动点或冷却限制，每个回合都能直接调动完整力量。
hooks.excerpt: No mana, no action points, no cooldowns! Be powerful every turn in a game that rewards your decisions.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 拼合相同碎片修复遗物，并收集同类型遗物强化能力与协同。
hooks.excerpt: Restore your artifacts by assembling multiple identical fragments, unlock new abilities, and strengthen your synergies by collecting relics of the same type.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每个遗物槽位同时给予独特增益与代价，有限槽位本身就是构筑约束。
hooks.excerpt: Relics need slots to be used so choose them carefully: each one grants a unique bonus but also a drawback that shapes your playstyle.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: Pros: +Amazing meta-progression +Balance +Build variety +Difficulty +Refreshing features for the genre +Unique and fun to play Cons: -Secondary storyline and music -Few mods and complications, but maybe they'll add them after leaving EA -A few small bugs, but forgivable at this stage (considering the volume of mechanics) The project is somewhat reminiscent of Griftlands.
